deck.name: Expert Round
deck.description: A demanding mix of mathematics, ancient scripts, molecular biology, astronomy, music and obscure words.

questions.prompt: Which SI base unit measures luminous intensity?
questions.explanation: Lumens measure luminous flux; lux measures illuminance.

questions.prompt: How many bytes are in one kibibyte?
questions.explanation: Kibibyte is the binary unit. The SI prefix kilo means 1000.

questions.prompt: For a convex polyhedron, what is V minus E plus F?
questions.explanation: This is Euler's formula for vertices, edges and faces.

questions.prompt: Which number is perfect, meaning it equals the sum of its positive proper divisors?
questions.explanation: Its positive proper divisors are 1, 2, 4, 7 and 14, which sum to 28.

questions.prompt: What is the derivative of e to the power x with respect to x?
choices: x times e to the power x
e to the power x minus one
questions.explanation: The natural exponential function is its own derivative.

questions.prompt: Which element has the chemical symbol W?
questions.explanation: The symbol comes from the alternative name wolfram.

questions.prompt: Which element was the first to be identified through artificial production?
questions.explanation: Technetium was identified in irradiated material in 1937; traces also occur naturally.

questions.prompt: Which metal sits at the center of a chlorophyll molecule?
What does ATP stand for in cell biology?
questions.explanation: Cells couple ATP breakdown to many energy-requiring processes.

questions.prompt: What model of DNA replication did the Meselson-Stahl experiment support?
questions.explanation: Each daughter DNA double helix contains one parental strand and one newly synthesized strand.

questions.prompt: What does the spliceosome normally remove from a pre-mRNA transcript?
questions.explanation: The remaining exons are joined to form mature RNA.

questions.prompt: A chain of ubiquitin molecules often marks a protein for destruction by what?
questions.explanation: Ubiquitin has other signaling roles too; not every ubiquitin modification means degradation.

questions.prompt: During which meiotic phase do sister chromatids separate?
questions.explanation: Homologous chromosomes separate in anaphase I.

questions.prompt: What does an isobath connect on a map?
What does an isohel connect on a map?
Which year is associated with the Peace of Westphalia ending the Thirty Years' War?
The 1494 Treaty of Tordesillas divided overseas claims between which two crowns?
questions.explanation: The agreement set a line of demarcation; it did not recognize the rights of peoples already living there.

questions.prompt: Linear B records an early form of which language?
questions.explanation: It was used to write Mycenaean Greek.

questions.prompt: Which script is not on the Rosetta Stone?
questions.explanation: The stone has three scripts but two languages: Egyptian and Greek.

questions.prompt: Which empire used knotted-cord records called quipus?
Which major key has four sharps in its standard key signature?
questions.explanation: The sharps are F, C, G and D.

questions.prompt: How many semitones make up a tritone?
questions.explanation: It divides the twelve-semitone octave in half.

questions.prompt: Which interlocking rhyme scheme did Dante use in The Divine Comedy?
questions.explanation: Its rhyme pattern proceeds ABA BCB CDC.

questions.prompt: What is chiasmus?
choices: Repeating the same word at sentence openings
Reversing the order of corresponding phrases
Omitting conjunctions from a series of clauses
Substituting a part for the name of a whole

questions.prompt: What constraint defines a lipogram?
choices: Using every alphabet letter in each sentence
Writing every line as a perfect palindrome
Repeating one word at the start of every line

questions.prompt: What does melismatic singing do?
choices: Uses one note for each syllable
Uses only spoken words without pitch
Uses only wordless humming on one note
Uses several notes for one syllable

questions.prompt: Who built the H4 timekeeper to help solve the longitude problem?
Which sea is defined by ocean currents rather than land boundaries?
questions.explanation: It lies within the North Atlantic subtropical gyre.

questions.prompt: The Chandrasekhar limit concerns the maximum supported mass of which object?
questions.explanation: For an idealized white dwarf it is about 1.4 times the Sun's mass.

questions.prompt: The James Webb Space Telescope operates near which Sun-Earth Lagrange point?
questions.explanation: Webb follows a halo orbit around the L2 region, not a fixed point motionless in space.

questions.prompt: The Riemann hypothesis predicts that nontrivial zeta-function zeros have what real part?
Which mathematician is associated with the incompleteness theorems?
questions.explanation: They establish limits on sufficiently expressive formal systems.

questions.prompt: In a normal 4 by 4 magic square using 1 through 16, what is the common row sum?
questions.explanation: The numbers total 136, and four equally summed rows must each total 34.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the short story The Library of Babel?
Who wrote the novel Pale Fire?
Which amino acid is strongly associated with the taste called umami?
questions.explanation: Glutamate salts contribute the savory taste recognized as umami.

questions.prompt: Every real transcendental number is irrational.
questions.explanation: Every rational number satisfies a polynomial equation with integer coefficients, so it is algebraic.

questions.prompt: The SI kilogram is still defined by the mass of a particular metal cylinder.
questions.explanation: Since 2019, its definition fixes the numerical value of the Planck constant.

questions.prompt: What is a hapax legomenon?
questions.answer: A word or expression occurring only once within a specified text or body of texts.

questions.prompt: What is aphelion?
questions.answer: The point in an orbit around the Sun that is farthest from the Sun.
